oracle_kind: the compset's own cycle 0 -- nucleation on fault 0 through arrest

event.note: Fault 0 nucleates from the seeded patch, ruptures its velocity-weakening region and arrests inside its own segment; the outer ~20 km never slips. Fault 1 does NOT rupture in this cycle -- 0.03 m on 10 of 234 nodes, creep-level. That is a property of THIS cycle only: in a 5-cycle run the segments alternate, and cycle 2 is a through-going event in which both slip 15.08 m after a 478 yr interseismic period. The step-over is a conditional barrier, not an absolute one. See reference/bp1002/README.md.

files.note: disp.*.nc omitted: no comparison reads them (rule 8a). user_defined_params.py is kept so the gold can be replotted (rules 18/19).

provenance.note: create.newcase -> case.setup -> run.sh (rule 19), binary checked against src/globalvar.f90 first.

caveat: First reference for BP1002; a regression lock, not a validation, not checked against any prior oracle. Cycle 0 is the first event from an artificial initial condition and is not representative of the multicycle behaviour -- see the 5-cycle table in the README before quoting anything from it.
